desc:
💥 CLONE PLAYGROUND 💥
Build. Clone. Destroy.

A physics sandbox where you create the setup and decide what happens next. Spawn clones of yourself, customize their look and weapons, and put your wildest ideas to the test.

🧍 Create and customize your clones 🧍
⚔️ Equip weapons and watch the realistic injury system ⚔️ 
🏗️ Spawn buildings, props, and vehicles 🏗️
🌀 Pick up, throw, attract, and repel 🌀
🔥 Burn structures down and trigger explosions 🔥
🧪 Experiment with chemicals, giant clones, zombies, healing, and revival 🧪

Build something ridiculous, send your clones flying, or turn a simple experiment into a complete disaster. Combine your tools and powers to discover what’s possible.

Your playground. Your rules.

We want to see what you create! Share your clips, suggestions, and feedback with our community.

🚨🚨 ALL PRIVATE SERVERS HAVE ALL GOD POWERS, UNLIMITED BUILD LIMIT, AND A 20 CLONE LIMIT AUTOMATICALLY!! 🚨🚨
